usage: Per hit: E_spec *= (1 - s_b); E_scatter = 1 - prod(1 - s_b). Specular tap amplitude sqrt(prod(1-s)); scattered share -> short Lambert-envelope velvet cluster, feed-forward on the early tap only. Muted face contributes neither absorption nor scattering.
